adaptation.reason: Made the centers and the visible incidence at P explicit to avoid relying on an unlabeled center convention. Replaced the source radius arrow by the required parallel dashed distance marker.

audit.independent_solution: The large radius PR is 4. The smaller circle passes through P and R with its center Q on PR, so PR is its diameter. Its radius is 4/2=2, option B.
